```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Free Pascal
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y fpc fp-compiler fpc-source fp-units-fcl fp-units-rtl fp-units-base fp-units-math fp-units-threads
        
    - name: Build tests
      run: |
        cd tests
        fpc -O3 -Fu../neural RunTests.lpr
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cd tests
        ./RunTests
```
